_doc: Blog EN · Restaurant Checklists Kit Pro (SPEC checklists-kit §7 punto 6, 17-oct-2026). El id es el del CATÁLOGO
(products-catalog.ts), que con urlByLang.en pinta la landing EN /en/digital-products/restaurant-checklist-templates y $19.
Posts: los cuatro del blog EN que más hablan de checklists, aperturas, cierres y rutinas por puesto (Restaurant Manager,
Executive Chef, Bartender Consultant y el pilar de la brigada). Ningún post EN enlazaba a /kit-tareas (nada que re-apuntar
con fase8x-banners-tienda-idioma.py). Víctimas = SLUGS EN de la landing: se sacrifican el Restaurant Financial Plan Kit,
el Inventory Kit y el Food Cost Kit; nunca el HACCP Kit, que es la venta cruzada del propio producto (SPEC D10).

prompt-library-restaurant-manager.parrafo: Prompts work best on top of a routine that is already written down. The {ENLACE} has the daily, weekly and monthly manager checklists, the shift handover and the opening and closing lists by area: 491 tasks in Excel, ready to print and initial.

kitchen-brigade-system.parrafo: Every station in a brigade has its own routine before, during and after service. The {ENLACE} puts it on paper: checklists for the hot line, the cold station and mise en place, plus the daily duties of the head chef and the sous chef, ready to print and initial.

prompt-library-executive-chef.parrafo: SOPs only stick when the team sees them every shift. The {ENLACE} turns the daily ones into printable lists: kitchen opening and closing, station checklists before, during and after service, and a weekly deep clean by zone, with temperatures in °F under the FDA Food Code.

prompt-library-bartender-consulting.parrafo: A bar program also runs on the work guests never see. The {ENLACE} includes bar opening and closing checklists, the bartender's daily duties and side work, and a cash drawer count with the over/short against the POS Z report.
